port_tag: Structure from the operator's production 2LoD practice; all names, values, and dates seeded.

journey.name: Instant Transfer
journey.posture: 2LoD independent observation · no findings · no verdicts · seeded telemetry
journey.sor_note: The GRC system of record retains all ratings; this surface is a read-only lens on signals the platform already runs — no new work, no rating changes.
journey.description: A customer moves money from their account to an external destination in near-real-time. The one journey a board can ask about in one sentence: can customers move money, how fast, and what is riding on the path?

slo.basis: seeded targets in the plausible band for consumer instant-transfer products; production replaces with the journey's real SLO record

stages.name: Initiate
stages.question: Can the customer start a transfer?

stages.name: Risk check
stages.question: Do we trust this transfer and this customer, right now?

stages.name: Ledger
stages.question: Did the money move exactly once, in order, on our books?

stages.name: Rails
stages.question: Did the external rail accept it?

stages.name: Settle & reconcile
stages.question: Does everyone — customer, ledger, partner — agree it happened?

services.non_claim: External rail — unobservable beyond acknowledgment. No internal-telemetry claim is made for the partner's side of this hop.

incident.name: event-bus consumer-lag storm

narrative_steps.label: Local lag
narrative_steps.text: event-bus consumer lag builds past its seeded baseline — the work-queue solvency question opens (RP-11's territory).
narrative_steps.do_not_overclaim: Lag alone does not identify an originating service; the seed of the buildup is not claimed.

narrative_steps.label: Business latency
narrative_steps.text: ledger-writer p99 degrades roughly five-fold as writes queue behind the lag — the customer-visible stage of the path slows.
narrative_steps.do_not_overclaim: Correlation in the same window; per-request causality is not traced.

narrative_steps.label: Retry amplification
narrative_steps.text: write retries climb — retry traffic feeds the queue it is stuck behind: the amplification loop the engine prices as load-dependent induction (β).
narrative_steps.do_not_overclaim: Retry-fuel share of total lag is not decomposed.

narrative_steps.label: Self-recovery
narrative_steps.text: The loop drains and every signal returns to baseline within ~2 hours. No customer-visible failure, no page, no ticket — the self-concealing shape. Divergence signals, not level metrics, are what would have caught it early.
narrative_steps.do_not_overclaim: Self-recovery is observed in the seeded series; operator intervention absence is a property of the simulation, not a claim about production behavior.

incident.so_what: One seeded event, four steps, zero alerts — the journey's riskiest hour is invisible to level-based monitoring. This is the concrete, dated form of the abstract number the workbench prices.
